import paddle
import paddle.nn as nn

class DL_Model(nn.Layer):
    def __init__(self):
        super(DL_Model, self).__init__()
        self.conv = nn.Conv2D(in_channels=3, out_channels=3, kernel_size=3, stride=1, padding=1)
        self.relu = nn.ReLU()
        self.flatten = nn.Flatten()
        self.linear = nn.Linear(in_features='mask', out_features=10)

    def forward(self, x):
        # the initial shape of x is: (1, 3, 32, 32)
        x = self.conv(x)  # output tensor shape: (1, 3, 32, 32)
        x = self.relu(x)  # output tensor shape: (1, 3, 32, 32)
        x = self.flatten(x)  # output tensor shape: (1, 3072)
        x = self.linear(x)
        return x

if __name__ == "__main__":
    model = DL_Model()
    input_tensor = paddle.randn((1, 3, 32, 32))  # Example input shape for CIFAR-10
    output_tensor = model(input_tensor)
    print(output_tensor.shape)
